_doc: . Read by .claude/forge-bin/forge-harness-score.cjs. Each category scores round(earned / max x 10) over the checks that could be measured; a check whose input is absent (no --doctor-json, a missing tool or file) is 'not_measured' and leaves the max, so a missing input never looks like a pass or a fail. Overall = round(10 x sum(weight x earned/max) / sum(weight)) over measured categories. Change a check, its points or a weight only on purpose and bump 'version': the score is only comparable between runs on the same rubric version.
